topics.topic: Whether accepted no-op audited actions create an AuditEntry and retain a confirmation id
questions: Does an accepted action that returns an unchanged record create an AuditEntry and confirmation id, or are entries created only when state actually changes?
Does an accepted invocation of an audited action create an AuditEntry when it returns an existing record unchanged, or only when the invocation actually changes state?
When a confirmed archive or anonymise action succeeds by returning an unchanged record, is an AuditEntry created, and is its confirmation id retained?

judgement.why: The topic asks the same question as P2 about AuditEntry creation and confirmation retention for accepted no-op actions, and the relevant texts have not changed.

precedent.topic: AuditEntry creation and confirmation retention for accepted no-op actions
quotes:

Which actions must state
the revision they were made against is State 2's (carried, R0-35).
precedent.why: Whether a confirmed invocation is accepted, refused, treated as a no-op, and consequently emits an audit entry or confirmation id is an operation rule owned by State 2.

topics.topic: How a newly created erasure AuditEntry is handled when it predates a future cutoff
questions: If the owner gives a future cutoff date, so the new erasure entry is itself older than that date, does that new entry survive, is it erased too, or is such a cutoff refused?

topics.topic: How customer erasure affects the revision and last-changed pair
questions: When a Customer is erased, does the erasure move and retain its revision/last-changed pair, move it only transiently before discarding it, or remove it without moving it?

topics.topic: Whether an imported project requires a new display name or preserves the source name
questions: Must every imported project receive a new display name, or does an omitted replacement preserve the source display name?
